summary: The customer wants a proposed in-line method and probe to monitor sucrose concentration in a clear aqueous solution flowing through a 50 mm pipe.

facts_stated.text: They produce a clear, colourless aqueous sucrose solution.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We produce a clear, colourless aqueous sucrose solution

facts_stated.text: They want to monitor its sucrose concentration in-line.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: want to monitor its sucrose concentration in-line.

facts_stated.text: The solution flows through a 50 mm stainless steel pipe at 20 to 30 °C and normal pressure.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: The solution flows through a 50 mm stainless steel pipe at 20 to 30 °C and normal pressure

facts_stated.text: The expected range is 5 to 15 % w/w.
The quality limit is plus or minus 0.3 % w/w.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: our quality limit is plus or minus 0.3 % w/w.

facts_stated.text: The laboratory refractometer is the reference method and stays in use.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Our laboratory refractometer is the reference method and stays in use.

facts_stated.text: The analyser can stand in a dry, safe room 10 m from the pipe.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: The analyser can stand in a dry, safe room 10 m from the pipe

facts_stated.text: The line is cleaned in place with hot caustic once a day.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: the line is cleaned in place with hot caustic once a day.

facts_stated.text: A reading every minute is enough.
